capabilities: write flashcards as Question::Answer lines under tagged headings
schedule reviews with FSRS and configurable target retention
organize cards into nested decks from nested tags
review cards with keyboard shortcuts and cram mode
track review history, retention and due forecasts
extras: Pre-1.0: the card format, settings and data file may still change, though the author says migrations will be handled. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation also documented via BRAT (Sejder/retain) or manual file download; requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. The README states the plugin makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in flashcard system, and existing approaches append scheduling comments or IDs into the notes themselves.

relations.evidence: Retain schedules them with FSRS, the algorithm modern Anki uses

summary: Spaced-repetition flashcard plugin that schedules Question::Answer lines with FSRS while keeping all review data out of your notes.
